doc_title: NOTICE OF REVOCATION OF A POWER OF ATTORNEY
doc_title_official: NOTICE OF REVOCATION OF A POWER OF ATTORNEY
when_used: Tells the land registry that a power of attorney entered in the register of powers of attorney has been revoked.

body_text.text: The Applicant noted above HEREBY GIVE NOTICE that the Power of Attorney filed in the register of powers of attorney as No {{power_of_attorney_number}} has been revoked:-
by the death / bankruptcy/ disability of the Donor*; or
by the death / disability of the Donee.*
And the Applicant attaches the following documents in support thereof:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this revocation of Power of Attorney has been duly executed this .............................…. day of…………………….. 20…………….

registry_block: REGISTERED in the Register of Powers of Attorney as No. ................. this …………….. day of …………………............……………20…….
foot_notes: indicate: Name; I.D/Passport No./PIN. If corporate body provide registration details.

custom_fields.name: applicant_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the person giving this notice

custom_fields.name: donee_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Donee
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the attorney whose power is revoked

custom_fields.name: registered_proprietor_donor
custom_fields.label: Registered proprietor and Donor
custom_fields.prompt: Name, identity card or passport number and PIN of the registered proprietor who gave the power of attorney, as the form's own note asks

custom_fields.name: power_of_attorney_number
custom_fields.label: Number of the power of attorney
custom_fields.prompt: The number under which the power of attorney is filed in the register of powers of attorney

custom_fields.name: supporting_documents
custom_fields.label: Documents attached in support
custom_fields.prompt: The documents lodged with this notice, for example a death certificate or a deed of revocation
